# Attribulina type schema, generated by scripts/gen_schema.py. Do not edit by hand:
# rerun the script (see its docstring for the decisions it makes).
# Nitro on the Wii. Its types come from an older Wii build's DWARF (exes/wii/nitro-japan-oldelf/nfs_na_f.elf,
# offsets, no namespaces), then Carbon's PS3 dump for the ones it lacks, as Undercover's Wii schema has
# them, and scripts/nitro/nitro_types.h for the types of its own, from the retail files and code. Each
# struct has the size of the retail type table; a type that build sizes otherwise is left to the others.
schema nitro "Need for Speed: Nitro" wii
